nagpur.advisory: Dry and clear weather expected. Suitable for cotton picking and foliar spray in morning hours.

pune.advisory: Partly cloudy with light isolated drizzle. Monitor onion plots for thrips and avoid irrigation if rain occurs.

nashik.advisory: Clear weather. Good conditions for onion curing and Rabi sowing.

latur.advisory: Dry weather. Conserve soil moisture in Rabi chickpea and sorghum.

akola.advisory: Clear sky. Safe window for harvesting and safe storage of cotton.

indore.advisory: Mild temperatures. Favorable for wheat sowing and irrigation scheduling.

lucknow.advisory: Cool mornings and mild days. Monitor early wheat for CRI stage irrigation.

karnal.advisory: Cool morning dew; inspect wheat crop for early yellow rust symptoms.
